title: Paired downstream integration review of change and MCP boundaries
problem: ChangeRuntime, WorkspaceRuntime, and the MCP adapter share security and publication boundaries; a separate integration reviewer should validate those real package tests under the same measured routing protocol.

acceptanceCriteria.condition: The independent integration reviewer has an executed no-route baseline captured before its overlapping verification intent.
The integration reviewer receives an explainable ImpactDetected route from its overlapping intent without a task-board dependency.
Two bounded replays are identical and the unrelated observer receives no routed context.
An independent reviewer workspace runs the real ChangeRuntime, MCP-adapter, and WorkspaceRuntime tests and records exact counts.
Coordination is controlled by a distinct, remotely qualified stable predecessor and the candidate daemon is not started.

evidencePlan.coordination: Persist the paired route arms, intent reasons, replay, observer result, WorkItem completion, and stable predecessor authority.
evidencePlan.evaluation: Do not label a passing integration review as a feedback repair cycle; preserve only what was actually observed.
evidencePlan.correctness: Bind the real integration test command/output and current candidate check-runs to this task result.

observedEvidenceBoundary: OT-010 is a real downstream integration review over my-pi package boundaries. It adds heterogeneous observed evidence but does not by itself satisfy PN6/PN8 promotion criteria.
